rca_of_the_issue: Root cause: In models.py, the City Hub enum classes (ApplicationStatus, AppointmentStatus, AnnouncementStatus, AdSlotStatus, AdSlotPosition) were defined as 'class EnumName(str, Enum)' where Enum was imported from SQLAlchemy (line 5: 'from sqlalchemy import ... Enum ...'). This caused the enums to not have the .value attribute that Python's enum.Enum provides. The fix was to change all these classes to inherit from 'enum.Enum' (Python's enum module) instead of SQLAlchemy's Enum. Additionally, in announcements.py, the audit log was trying to access .value on a string that was already the enum value.
